key_points: Q2 2026 results triggered modest fair value increase from $181.85 to $185.75 (~2.1%)
JPMorgan upgraded stock ahead of Q2; EPS expectation $2.27
Company returned $1.4B to shareholders in Q2 ($400M dividends + $1B buybacks)
Turnaround narrative cited as progressing faster than expected post-litigation
Analyst revisions mixed but net slightly positive on organic growth and execution
